name: dy0
expr: if(n > 0, B / 2 * (sin(90 deg * 1 / n) - sin(90 deg * 0 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dz0
expr: if(n > 0, D * (cos(90 deg * 0 / n) - cos(90 deg * 1 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dy1
expr: if(n > 1, B / 2 * (sin(90 deg * 2 / n) - sin(90 deg * 1 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dz1

name: dy2

name: dz2

name: dy3

name: dz3

name: Akey
expr: r1^2 * (pi + 2 * alK / 1 rad) / 2 + r2^2 * (pi - 2 * alK / 1 rad) / 2 + (r1 + r2) * dK * cos(alK)

name: Pkey
expr: r1 * (pi + 2 * alK / 1 rad) + r2 * (pi - 2 * alK / 1 rad) + 2 * dK * cos(alK)

name: Akey1
expr: (r1 + riserT)^2 * (pi + 2 * alK / 1 rad) / 2 + (r2 + riserT)^2 * (pi - 2 * alK / 1 rad) / 2 + (r1 + r2 + 2 * riserT) * dK * cos(alK)

name: Akey2
expr: (r1 + riserT + lipW)^2 * (pi + 2 * alK / 1 rad) / 2 + (r2 + riserT + lipW)^2 * (pi - 2 * alK / 1 rad) / 2 + (r1 + r2 + 2 * (riserT + lipW)) * dK * cos(alK)

name: mPanels
expr: rhoPly * tVol * (2 * (Ap0 + Ap1 + Ap2 + Ap3) * tHull + 2 * ApD * tDeck)

name: mxPanels
expr: rhoPly * tVol * 2 * ((Mxp0 + Mxp1 + Mxp2 + Mxp3) * tHull + MxpD * tDeck)

name: mzPanels
expr: rhoPly * tVol * 2 * ((Mzp0 + Mzp1 + Mzp2 + Mzp3) * tHull + MzpD * tDeck)

name: mxGlass
expr: 2 * (glassHull * (Mxp0 + Mxp1 + Mxp2 + Mxp3) + glassDeck * MxpD) / (1 m)^2

name: mzGlass
expr: 2 * (glassHull * (Mzp0 + Mzp1 + Mzp2 + Mzp3) + glassDeck * MzpD) / (1 m)^2

name: mCoam
expr: rhoWood * tVol * (Pkey * riserT * 70 mm + (Pkey + pi * (riserT + lipW)) * (lipW + riserT) * lipT)

name: mHole
expr: rhoPly * tVol * Akey / cd * tDeck + glassDeck * Akey / cd / (1 m)^2

name: xMoveOff
expr: (mCoam * offCoam - mHole * offCoam + mBulk / 2 * (legReach - bkAft)) / mMove

B
label: Beam
description: Widest beam at the sheer (the hull-deck joint); at least 570 mm with one chine, whose V bottom needs more beam for the same stability

name: D
label: Depth at the sheer
description: Height of the sheer above the keel at the widest station; the deck's crown comes on top. At most 0.36 x beam: deeper hulls carry their weight too high

name: crown
label: Deck crown
description: Angle of the deck panels from the horizontal

name: rockB
label: Bow rise
description: Rocker: how high the keel rises to the bow tip (Greenland ends: 250-350 mm)

name: rockS
label: Stern rise
description: How high the keel rises to the stern tip

name: xmax
label: Widest station
description: Where the beam is widest, as a fraction of the length from the stern (below 0.5: swede form)

name: chines
label: Chines per side
description: Hard chines between keel and sheer on each side: 1 to 3, so 2 to 4 hull panels a side

name: form
label: Ends
description: How fast the bottom panels taper out towards the ends: fine ends are faster, full ends carry more

name: mPad
label: Paddler weight (kg)
description: The paddler, in kg: with the boat and the load it sets the waterline

name: hPad
label: Paddler height
description: Stature: sets the paddler's centre of gravity, the cockpit's length and the foot brace

name: payload
label: Load (kg)
description: Gear in the fore and aft compartments, in kg, half in each

name: water
label: Water
description: Sea water (1025 kg/m3) or fresh water (1000 kg/m3)

name: tHull
label: Hull plywood
description: Okoume plywood for the hull panels and bulkheads (4 mm usual)

name: tDeck
label: Deck plywood
description: Okoume plywood for the deck panels (3 mm usual)

name: cockL
label: Cockpit length
description: Keyhole opening, inside: at least the buttock-knee length (0.34 x stature) plus room behind the seat back

name: cockW
label: Cockpit width
description: Keyhole opening, inside, at its widest (aft) end

name: hatches
label: Bulkheads and hatches
description: Fore and aft bulkheads with round hatches (off: an open hull for float bags)

title: Sea kayak (stitch and glue)
description: A Greenland-style multichine sea kayak in okoume plywood, built stitch and glue. Every hull panel is a developable surface whose flat outline is computed from the hull's formulas, with stitch holes and puzzle joints, ready to cut. The waterline, trim, stability (GM), prismatic coefficient and wetted surface follow the paddler, the load and the lines, and are checked against the exact geometry. Export the sets Cut sheet: hull panels and Cut sheet: deck (DXF or SVG).
